name: Erika
source: A shapeshifter who can’t remember her past. She works as a spy and scout for Virgil, who saved her from a secret lab a few years ago. She tends to be brusque but also folds under the slightest bit of pressure. Because of her meek personality, she got the attention of Sarah, who thinks Erika could be easily pressured to switch sides if needed.
